title: Delete specific files
summary: Permanently removes one or more files from the system. This action cannot be undone easily, so double-check the file paths before running the command.

steps.explain: Removes the specified files. If a file does not exist, the command will report an error unless you use the force flag.

placeholders.name: FILE_PATHS
placeholders.description: One or more paths to the files you want to delete.

warnings: Deleted files are not moved to the Trash/Recycle Bin and cannot be easily recovered.
Ensure you have selected the correct files before running the command.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in command to undo file deletion. You must restore from a backup if available.
